I implemented exactly that design.

RESOLVED.the_cause: My own bug, and it was in the code the whole time. `_damage_difference` was computed INSIDE roll_components_agree from its `observed`/`engine` arguments -- but the equal-length caller passes ONE component at a time, and _roll_damage_scale excludes heals. For a heal pair the local value is therefore 0 and the bound collapses to 1 HP.
RESOLVED.why_it_evaded_four_rounds: The bound was far TIGHTER than intended, which is the opposite of what I asserted for three rounds. My offline analysis computed the damage difference from the FULL miss lists and concluded the sound bound was LOOSER (300 accepts vs 180) -- a correct calculation of a quantity the code never computes. The proxy disagreed with the program and I trusted the proxy.
RESOLVED.the_fix: thread the slot-wide (obs_damage, eng_damage) pair from both call sites, exactly as slot_scale used to be threaded.
RESOLVED.the_result: 64 divergent -- BETTER than the loose version's 67, with a bound that is sound. All five impossible pairs still reject and all 88 tests pass. So the sound design was right all along; my implementation of it was wrong, and every conclusion I drew from that measurement was an artifact of my own defect.
RESOLVED.found_by: the mechanical step I should have taken first: diff the tree that produced the 67 against the current one and read what actually differs, instead of naming candidates from reasoning. It took one diff.

DECOMPOSITION.source: independent review, single-variable sweeps on one tree, engine byte-identical throughout
DECOMPOSITION.the_correction: The bound redesign I made the centrepiece -- and got wrong across four rounds -- is worth 3 of 144 rows. The substance is threading a slot-wide damage budget into a comparison that was operating on 1 HP. Main's 0.18*scale+1 was never operative either: its caller does not pass scale, so production ran at 1 HP too.
DECOMPOSITION.the_67_was_never_a_mystery: reconstructing main's fraction bound WITH the threading scores 67 on the current tree, to the row. The 'unlocated gap' of the previous four rounds was this.
